attchmntText: Barak Valley Cements Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Submission of revised results'.
voiceSummary: Barak Valley Cements Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Standalone and Consolidated Un-Audited Financial Results for the Second quarter and year ended 30th September 2026. The Statutory Auditor issued a Limited Review Report with an unmodified opinion. The company also approved Related Party Transactions for the period. Standalone Total Assets stood at 21,079.20 Lakhs as of 30th September 2026, compared to 19,615.45 Lakhs at 31st March 2026. Standalone Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities was 127.10 Lakhs for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Certificates from the CEO and CFO were submitted pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. The results will be published in newspapers.
